description: doctrine — shows each dispatched seat while it runs. In a herdr session (HERDR_ENV=1) it panes the seat directly; in a contained agent (DCTR_VIEW_REQUEST_DIR set) it only writes a request file to that mount for a host-side watcher, calling no herdr. With neither set it stands down, costing one process spawn per hook event and nothing else — and that is more than one per seat: Claude Code also fires SubagentStop for its own forked queries (a prompt suggestion after most turns, memory extraction), each with an empty agent_type, so a session that dispatches no seats still spawns roughly once per turn. SessionStart after /clear (matcher clear) runs dctr-restore.mjs: when SESSION_MEMORY.md's kickoff names a handoff whose record's last state line reads Open or Blocked, it hands the new session the phase, the record path, that state line, the wrapper and the handoff as facts; otherwise it prints nothing and calls no herdr. PostToolBatch runs dctr-gauge.mjs: while that record is Open or Blocked and its last auto-cycle on/off line is on, it reads the main session's context use and, the first time it reaches the record's tier, hands the session the warning as facts and appends `- auto-cycle: warned <session id> <tier>` to the record, once per session id; a seat's batch (agent_id present) and every other case stand down, and it calls no herdr.
